# A globally optimal finite-temperature passive resonator cell

Owned construction: physical_opportunity_fresh. Internal mathematical result, pending independent review. Historical novelty and physical material performance remain UNKNOWN.

## 1. Exact physical model and resource contract

An infinite periodic one-dimensional harmonic material has exactly one scalar backbone coordinate per unit cell. That backbone coordinate, of positive mass m, is connected to its counterpart in adjacent cells by a positive spring K. Any finite connected passive internal network of additional positive point masses and positive linear springs can attach within the cell. Total cell mass is M, fixed. Arbitrary topology, arbitrarily many optical modes, arbitrarily large internal stiffness and arbitrary dark modes are allowed to the comparator. No active element, damping, reservoir, negative stiffness or extra intercell bond is supplied.

Mass-normalize the cell. For q in [0,pi],
D(q)=D0+s(q) v v^T,  s(q)=4K sin^2(q/2),
where D0 is PSD, has the unique rigid-translation nullvector z normalized to unit length, ||v||^2=1/m, and (z^T v)^2=1/M.

There is a fixed positive lower bound m>=m_min on the backbone mass. In the explicit example m_min=1. This avoids the singular massless-backbone trick. M and K are identical for every competitor. Static long-wave stiffness is K, and acoustic speed (for fixed cell spacing a) is a sqrt(K/M), identical to the rigid-mass chain.

Transport is ideal-contact harmonic BALLISTIC thermal conductance of this infinite periodic spectrum, with unit transmission in each pass band. It is not diffusive conductivity, finite-contact conductance, full 3D thermal conductivity, electronic transport, or a room-temperature material claim. Internal connector mass, finite specific modulus, physical atomic geometry, disorder and anharmonicity require a separate realization calculation. All finite masses in the declared network are included.

Let theta=k_B T/hbar. Apart from the factor k_B/(2pi), conductance is
J_theta = integral_0^infinity g_theta(omega) chi(omega) domega,
g_theta(omega)=[omega/(2theta)/sinh(omega/(2theta))]^2,
where chi is the union-of-pass-bands indicator. The explicit construction uses theta=1/2 in the chosen frequency unit.

# Universal attainable-spectrum design theorem for a passive phonon backbone

Status: owned internal mathematical construction; root whole-proof review found no substantive gap. Version3 retains the zero-coefficient clarification and makes the fixed frequency reference in the logarithmic design coordinates explicit. Original6092 and version2 bytes remain preserved unchanged. Earlier governing proof99f7440a and all prior certificates are preserved unchanged. This file generalizes its single engineered point. Historical novelty, material realization and mission-level physical capability remain unestablished.

## 1. Physical model and exact output

Fix K>0, total unit-cell mass M, a positive backbone-mass lower bound m0 with0<m0<M, and finite theta=k_B T/hbar>0. A finite passive connected internal network of positive scalar point masses and positive springs attaches within each cell to one backbone coordinate of mass m>=m0. The only intercell link connects that coordinate to its counterpart in adjacent cells with spring K. Internal topology, number of nodes, stiffnesses, and dark modes are otherwise unrestricted.

Mass normalization gives
D(q)=D0+4K sin^2(q/2) vv^T,
D0>=0 with exactly one rigid-translation nullmode,
||v||^2=1/m, and squared overlap of v with that normalized nullmode=1/M.

The output is full ideal-contact harmonic BALLISTIC thermal conductance, including every acoustic and optical pass band. Apart from k_B/(2pi),
J_theta(chi)=integral_0^infinity g_theta(w) chi(w)dw,
g_theta(w)=[w/(2theta)/sinh(w/(2theta))]^2.
It is a strictly positive, strictly decreasing function of w>0, equals1 at zero, and decays exponentially at infinity.

No full3D conductivity, electronic power factor, contact transport, finite-modulus fabrication or anharmonic material operation is supplied.

## 2. Main theorem

For EVERY such quadruple(K,M,m0,theta), the conductance minimum over ALL finite internal passive networks and all allocations m>=m0 is attained by a cell with:
- backbone mass exactly m0;
- ONE side mass M-m0;
- ONE finite positive internal spring k_*.

Its full passband spectrum and active driving-point response are unique. Distinct isospectral networks or additional dark modes can represent the same response, so physical topology is not asserted unique.
